attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry is the same martyr: of Tarsus in Cilicia, taken because he was a Christian, brought before Lysias the ruler of the place, and beheaded when torture could not bring him back to idolatry. **No `dates` proposed**: the only year on the page hangs on a reign — «έζησε στα χρόνια του Διοκλητιανού (284 - 304 μ.Χ.)» — which is the formula this corpus refuses, on the `carterius-of-caesarea` precedent; the reign is in the life paragraph instead. No `locations` either, the folder being undated. The page prints no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
